title: resources bound in if, match and try branches are destroyed when the branch ends, unless its value is used
purpose: Observe lexical lifetimes of branch bindings, the last let included (#308).

provenance.origin: authored for #308 from the Book (12.2, 20) and the owner's decision
provenance.expected_basis: Book 12.2: a block's bindings do not leak and objects owned there run destroy at its end, in reverse order; a branch passes its value out only when the value is used (K), and a throw destroys the branch's resources before the handler runs (J before caught); Log outlives every Res.
